prompts.title: Recent form: wins, draws and losses over the sample
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical frame on GoatLab charcoal #101412 with warm white #edf0e6 typography, lime #c5ed74 assigned to Paris Saint-Germain FC and slate #8ca6bf to FC Barcelona; every on-screen word is Spanish. The lower quarter of the frame is a permanent yellow subtitle band, and no chart, crest, label or caption may cross into it. The top two fifths hold the header: a small Spanish eyebrow «CHAMPIONS · FORMA» above the generic sports heading «ÚLTIMOS PARTIDOS», with both team names set in warm white bold underneath. A sample strip sits directly below the heading and is visible in both variants, reading «muestra: {{home.n}} partidos» beside the Paris crest and «muestra: {{away.n}} partidos» beside the Barcelona crest; the source line «source: Bzzoiro» runs in small slate capitals just above the subtitle band and stays on screen for the entire scene.

EDITORIAL PRESENTATION (played first): kinetic typography only, no axes, no gridlines, no numeric values. Both team names land from opposite edges on a hard beat, then the three Spanish words «VICTORIAS», «EMPATES» and «DERROTAS» punch in vertically stacked, one per beat, each scaling from three quarters to full size with a two-frame overshoot and a lime rim light on the Paris stack, a slate rim on the Barcelona stack. Rhythmic emphasis alternates left then right so the eye pulses between the two crests, while a thin lime sweep travels down the stack on each beat. Exit: the stacks collapse toward the centre and dissolve before reaching the subtitle band, handing off to the statistical card.

STATISTICAL PRESENTATION: grouped count bars on a shared zero baseline, unit partidos, one cluster per team. Three bars per cluster — «Victorias», «Empates», «Derrotas» — with values rendered from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}} and {{home.losses}} for Paris and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}} and {{away.losses}} for Barcelona. Bars grow from the baseline in 900 ms with a 120 ms stagger and are drawn to one common scale so the two clusters are directly comparable. Faint slate gridlines and warm-white tick numerals run up the left edge, with the axis title «partidos» set vertically. Because the two samples are shown as printed figures, add a small slate note «muestras distintas» beside the axis whenever the two sample counts differ, so unequal samples are never hidden; units and values are resolved by the renderer, never typed by hand.

CAMERA: slow vertical push from the full frame to a tighter crop on the taller cluster, then a gentle settle, no rotation. TRANSITION: the bars collapse into the baseline, the baseline lifts and becomes the seam that opens the next scene. EXIT: crest row and heading slide upward out of frame as the baseline wipe continues into scene two.

prompts.title: Goals for and against, both teams on one scale
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical. Charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 for Paris Saint-Germain FC, slate #8ca6bf for FC Barcelona. The lower quarter is kept clear for the permanent yellow subtitles; the pitch illustration, bars, callouts and crests all stop above that line. Spanish heading «GOLES» with the eyebrow «CHAMPIONS · ATAQUE Y DEFENSA», team names set under their own colours. The source line «source: Bzzoiro» appears in small slate capitals above the subtitle band, with the sample annotation «muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos» pinned beside it.

EDITORIAL PRESENTATION (primary): a stylised football pitch drawn in soft perspective inside the upper three fifths — two thin warm-white goal frames at either end, halfway line and centre circle as faint slate strokes, no real footage and no invented match events. A lime ball path starts in the Paris half, arcs through the middle and terminates in the Barcelona goal, then a mirrored slate path returns the other way; each path is drawn with a taper so motion reads as speed, with thin trails echoing behind it. Both team names reveal simultaneously in kinetic type while short Spanish phrases taken from the narration, such as «goles a favor» and «goles recibidos», ride along the arcs as small captions. Emphasis: the arcs brighten on impact and the pitch dims to two fifths brightness so the ball path is the single focal point. TRANSITION: the ball leaves frame and its trail flattens into the horizontal baseline of the statistical card.

STATISTICAL PRESENTATION: paired bars on one shared scale, unit goles, common zero baseline — Paris pair «Goles a favor» and «Goles recibidos» from {{home.gf}} and {{home.ga}}, Barcelona pair from {{away.gf}} and {{away.ga}}. Each pair occupies its own column, home column left in lime, away column right in slate; a thin dotted warm-white connector joins the two «recibidos» bars across the frame so the defensive comparison reads instantly. Values sit above each bar cap with the unit resolved by the renderer, the axis title «goles» runs vertically at the left, and faint gridlines sit behind. A small sample note restates the sample size so the bars are never read out of context, and both comparisons keep the same unit. CAMERA: lateral dolly left to right with shallow parallax between bars and gridlines. Emphasis: a warm-white pulse on each taller favour bar, a slate underline on each lower against bar. EXIT: bars retract into the baseline and the pitch outline fades last, wiping into the next scene.

prompts.title: Clean sheets: defensive counts with sample attached
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, charcoal #101412 ground, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 Paris Saint-Germain FC, slate #8ca6bf FC Barcelona. The lower quarter is reserved for the permanent yellow subtitle band; shields, numerals, legends and captions stay clear of it. Header: Spanish eyebrow «CHAMPIONS · DEFENSA» and the heading «ARCOS EN CERO», team names in their own colours. The source line «source: Bzzoiro» sits in small slate capitals above the subtitle band, with the sample annotation «muestra: {{home.n}} partidos» and «muestra: {{away.n}} partidos» attached to each crest so the counts are never separated from their sample.

EDITORIAL PRESENTATION (primary): defensive energy built from one stylised shield per team, each assembled from geometric plates that slide together and lock with a hard beat, edges catching a lime rim light on the Paris side and a slate rim on the Barcelona side. No axes, no values, no invented match events; the shield carries the metaphor of a clean sheet, and the motion is restrained and low-amplitude with short bursts of energy as each plate seats. Spanish words «SÓLIDO», «ORDENADO» and «SIN GOLES EN CONTRA» type in along each shield's vertical axis, one per beat, in warm white with tight tracking. Emphasis: a slow breathing glow pulses inside the shield and the assembly settles into stillness before the hand-off, because calm is the message here. TRANSITION: the two shields rotate to edge-on and split apart, leaving a thin vertical seam that widens into the statistical frame.

STATISTICAL PRESENTATION: two large numerals, resolved from {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}} in unit partidos, sitting on a shared baseline with a common scale and identical type size, each numeral scaled by its own value so the comparison stays honest. Beneath each numeral sit the Spanish label «ARCOS EN CERO» and its attached sample figure; the counts remain counts, and no rate, share or normalised figure is ever shown or implied, which keeps the sample sizes meaningful. Axis: a single faint baseline with tick marks, no gridlines needed, and the axis title «partidos» at the left in slate. CAMERA: slow vertical push-in that keeps both numerals inside the safe area above the subtitle band. Emphasis: the larger numeral lifts slightly and holds a warm-white outline while the other remains static. EXIT: the numerals shrink into the baseline, and that baseline becomes a horizontal wipe, transition into the duel scene.

prompts.title: Head-to-head history: duel of previous meetings
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 for Paris Saint-Germain FC, slate #8ca6bf for FC Barcelona, lower quarter reserved for the permanent yellow subtitle band. Eyebrow «CHAMPIONS» above the Spanish heading «CRUCES PREVIOS». The source line «source: Bzzoiro» and the sample annotation «muestra: {{h2h.total}} cruces» are displayed beside the heading in both variants, and the Spanish caption «HISTORIAL, NO PRONÓSTICO» stays visible throughout so these historical figures are never read as a forecast.

EDITORIAL PRESENTATION: a visual duel — the frame splits into two vertical halves with a razor-thin warm-white seam down the middle; the Paris crest and the Barcelona crest advance from the top and bottom edges toward the centre on the beat, then hold in a tense stand-off while the seam pulses. Kinetic Spanish phrases «MANO A MANO», «HISTORIA» and «DUELO» strike in on alternating sides with tight tracking and a short overshoot, and small angular shards scatter on each impact, all of it staying above the lower quarter. No axes, no values and no invented match events. Emphasis: the seam flares lime on the Paris side and slate on the Barcelona side, then calms to a steady line. TRANSITION: the seam opens into a full-width horizontal rule that becomes the segmented bar of the statistical card.

STATISTICAL PRESENTATION: one horizontal segmented bar spanning the full text width on a shared scale in unit partidos — the Paris segment rendered from {{h2h.homeWins}}, the draw segment from {{h2h.draws}} in warm white, and the Barcelona segment from {{h2h.awayWins}}; the total {{h2h.total}} is labelled at the right end of the bar as «total de cruces» with its sample attached. Segments grow left to right in 800 ms, each with its own Spanish legend chip: «Victorias PSG», «Empates», «Victorias FC Barcelona». Axis: a faint baseline with tick marks and the axis title «cruces»; values print inside a segment when it is wide enough, otherwise on a leader line above it. The comparison keeps one unit and one total sample throughout, and the historical framing stays explicit. CAMERA: slow sideways drift from the Paris end toward the Barcelona end, settling centred. Emphasis: a warm-white pulse travels across the draw segment. EXIT: the segments contract into the baseline, the seam returns as a vertical line and closes.
